messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.29-2 (only minor technical changes)
parts:
A new version of R/qtl (1.29-2) has been released at its web site
(http://www.rqtl.org) and on CRAN.

This is hardly worth announcing, as there were only minor technical
changes (the principal one dealing with a dependency in the QTLRel
package), but I felt I should, just so you'd know.

See http://www.rqtl.org/STATUS.txt for a complete list of changes.

Karl Broman
